question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Kind, generous, and forgiving.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Magnanimous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Magnanimous **means generous and forgiving, which perfectly captures the meaning of the group of words given in the question. (उदार और क्षमाशील)
 
• The word comes from the Latin roots Magnus (great) and animus (soul), so it literally means having a great soul.
 
 
• **Example**: *Despite being wronged by his friend, John showed a magnanimous spirit and forgave him.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnificent **means impressive or beautiful. (प्रभावशाली या सुंदर)
 
• **Grandiloquent **means using fancy or pompous language. (फैंसी या आडंबरपूर्ण भाषा का उपयोग करना)
 
• **Portentous **means indicating something important or ominous. (किसी महत्वपूर्ण या अशुभ बात का संकेत देना)
